messages:
nina: Quick check — rolling release/2026-03-rc1 (runtime v2.1.3) US -> EU -> APAC, start 21:30 UTC. Need ops/infra go/no-go for each region.
tom: US warm=13/12, canaries passed. EU warm=6/10 (drains), APAC warm=8/8 but spot risk ~10%.
maya: tagging @sre-oncall and @ops-bot for quotas + thermal. any active alerts?
sre-oncall: no active alerts. noticed EU JVM GC spikes during canary1, applied GC flags to canary nodes; p95 down from 175ms to 130ms. still warming.
deploy-bot: preflight:
```
US: warm=13 target=12 p95=110ms
EU: warm=6 target=10 p95=130ms (warming)
APAC: warm=8 target=8 p95=140ms spot-risk=10%
Global API headroom: 20%
Pinned plan: model-serving:v2.1.3, EU fallback=v2.1.2 (soft-pin)
```
tom: infra warm job queued for EU, ETA ~9m. ops-bot says API headroom enough but customer Y has low quota in EU (5% headroom).
ops-bot: infra-warm ETA 9m, per-customer quota alert threshold reached for customer Y if EU expands >15%.
maya: propose: proceed US 10%, wait 8m, if EU warm < target after 12m then soft-pin EU to v2.1.2. APAC: start with burst off for 20m.
nina: agree. rollback triggers: >0.5% absolute 5xx for 3m OR p95 > 250ms for 5m OR infra OOMs. manual approval for customer-impacting quota steps.
deploy-bot: US slice started 6478910008 (10%)
tom: US green at +6m. p95 108ms, 5xx flat. expanding US to 25%.
ops-bot: EU warm complete at 6478910065, warm=10. customer Y quota still at 5% headroom.
sre-oncall: EU canary running 4m, p95=135ms, 5xx slightly up 0.1% -> not alarming.
maya: EU will use soft-pin rule: if quota headroom <5% OR warm < target in 12m -> auto-pin EU to v2.1.2. enabled.
deploy-bot: EU canary started 6478910072
ops-bot: APAC spot risk dropping to 6% after reprovision. warm=9/8.
nina: starting APAC 6478910080 (15% slice, burst disabled). monitor 10m.
deploy-bot: APAC slice started 6478910080
ops-bot: notification posted to CS for customer Y about EU quota headroom.
sre-oncall: EU/APAC stable at last check. no infra alerts.
maya: adding release note: "release/2026-03-rc1 staged geo rollout; EU has soft-pin fallback for quota/warm failures; APAC burst disabled initial window." posting to #release-notes.
nina: closing thread when all regions stable for 30m. thanks all.
